lines.text: Jesus tells the hypocrite to first take the beam out of his own eye.
Jesus says to ask, seek and knock, and the door will be opened to you.
Jesus warns that false prophets come in sheep's clothing but inwardly are ravenous lions.
The wise man built his house on the rock and it stood, but the foolish man's house on sand fell.
The crowds were astonished because Jesus taught with authority, and not like their Pharisees.
